title: Dynamite Stick x37
body:
"Can be used to output a 'Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuge.:tm: explosion, with a large range. Any dynamite sticks which blow up other explosives will have a chain reaction, and explosives can be used to chop trees or break ores."

Description

The Dynamite Stick x37 has a very powerful explosion, and a very large radius. Like any other explosive, it damages trees and ores.

Unlike bombs, dynamite blows up almost instantly in a chain reaction.

The Dynamite Stick x37 can be bought from the Dugg's Digging

Location

The explosive is hidden in the rafters of Dugg's Digging.
